name: Barefoot Tours & Charters
subtitle: Private dolphin tours, fishing charters & jet ski adventures in Orange Beach, Alabama
description: We spend our time with families and small groups to celebrate life, birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, vacation time, and other very special moments in life through our family boat trips. We see dolphins in the wild up close 85% of the time and we make memories 100% of the time. Joining us on our family boat trips doesn't guarantee seeing dolphins or other amazing wildlife like some companies offer, but it does promise realistic opportunities to create unforgettable memories while we search for dolphins in the wild in subtropical calm back bay waters. We are a small company of friends and family that work, live, go to school, and church together. We live off God's natural blessings and show you amazing places while we play, swim, see dolphins, go tubing, and more. We have served thousands of families over the years with our fishing charters, customizing our time with you to do what you want, at your pace, not ours! We hope to meet y'all soon! We offer unforgettable dolphin tours, fishing charters, jet ski adventures, wave runner excursions, sunset cruises, and special celebration boat tours along the scenic intercoastal waterways of Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, Alabama. Our mission is to help you and your family engage in outdoor exploration and create memories that last a lifetime.
